title: Leader Election
subtitle: Pick a new leader in a fraction of a second, and require a majority so two never rule at once
motto: Exactly one leader, and only while a majority agrees
keyInsight: Election replaces a 15-minute manual fix with a sub-second failover, and a majority requirement stops split brain at the price of refusing writes on the minority side.

decisions.title: Show two leaders as the failure
decisions.description: The failure frame counts the seconds with two leaders and the conflicting writes they accept, which is the vault's split-brain scenario made numeric.
decisions.alternatives: Describing split brain in words would not show how many writes it corrupts.

decisions.title: Price the majority rule in rejected writes
decisions.description: The last frame charges the minority side's writes to the fix, so the availability cost of quorum is visible next to the conflicts it removes.
decisions.alternatives: Presenting quorum as free would hide that the cut-off side goes dark.
